headline: Global Dairy Trade Price Index Flat as Milk Powder Rises and Butter Falls
summary: The Global Dairy Trade (GDT) Price Index remained flat following three consecutive auction gains, as whole milk powder prices rose while butter and fat prices declined.
why: Global Dairy Trade auction results serve as an international benchmark for dairy commodity pricing and agricultural export revenues.

impacts.name: Global Dairy Trade Index
impacts.why: Auction results reflect global supply and demand pricing across key dairy product categories.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Mixed price movements across dairy categories, with higher whole milk powder offset by lower butter prices, left the GDT Price Index flat.
